title: Project Trainee
highlights: Developed a CycleGAN-based image-to-image translation system trained on 10,000+ artwork and painting images with TensorFlow and PyTorch.
Improved generated image quality by reducing Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) from 58.4 to 49.6 (~15%) through preprocessing, normalisation and hyperparameter tuning.
Evaluated models with FID and visual quality assessment, achieving more realistic texture transfer and style preservation.
